title: Edge zonal capacity launch - checklist, comms, and runbooks
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Launch coordination for adding three new edge/zonal Dedicated capacity SKUs across eu-north-1, ap-east-1, and us-west-3. Scope includes SKU pricing bands, reservation migration guidance, per-zone billing attribution, release notes sequencing, updated Console SKU selector, cross-region fallback policies, observability dashboards for zonal telemetry, and README/runbook for on-call. Outcome: safe, measurable ramp to GA with clear customer comms and documented rollback triggers.

acceptance_criteria: Console SKU selector surfaces new zone SKUs and 'prefer zone' UX and passes usability review
Billing export includes zone_id for reservations and matches per-customer invoice totals in test accounts
Canary run (50 instances) passes performance SLOs for 24 hours and telemetry shows no regressions
Release notes approved by Legal, Billing, and SRE and staged in coordinated sequence
Runbook includes rollback triggers and automated playbook for capacity failover
Customer migration guide for existing reservations (delta pricing, pro-rate) published

PM: Draft and sequence release notes, announce to pilot customers, and prepare customer migration Q&A
Support: Train Tier 1 with playbook and common troubleshooting flows

Docs: Publish 'How to migrate reservations between zones' with examples and pro-rate calculator
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Canary) - 2026-03-20: Provision 50 instances in eu-north-1. Monitor health, billing exports, and perf SLOs for 72 hours.
Phase 1 (Pilot) - 2026-03-24: Open zone SKUs to 10 pilot customers across all three zones. Provide dedicated SE support and run-through migration guide.
Phase 2 (Staged GA) - 2026-04-01: Gradual 25% increase per day across zones with telemetry gates. If any gate fails, automatically pause scaling and run rollback playbook.
Phase 3 (GA) - 2026-04-07: General availability. Publish public release notes, update pricing page, and enable console selector for all customers.
Post-GA (30 days): Assess usage, cost uplift, lodging final retrospective and follow-ups for billing edge cases
